ConvertInstance.description_en: Converts a pay-as-you-go instance to a subscription instance
ConvertInstance.description_zh: 您可以将按量付费的实例转换为包年包月的实例

ConvertPrepayInstance.description_en: Converts the billing method of an instance from subscription to pay-as-you-go

CreateInstance.description_en: Creates a subscription or pay-as-you-go fully managed Flink instance
CreateInstance.description_zh: 创建一个包年包月或者按量付费flink全托管实例

CreateNamespace.description_en: Creates a namespace in a fully managed Flink instance
CreateNamespace.description_zh: 在flink全托管实例中下创建项目空间

DeleteInstance.description_en: Deletes an unused pay-as-you-go fully managed Flink instance
DeleteInstance.description_zh: 删除未使用的按量付费的flink全托管实例

DeleteNamespace.description_zh: 删除未使用的项目空间

DescribeInstances.description_en: Queries the details of one or more fully managed Flink instances
DescribeInstances.description_zh: 查询一个或多个flink全托管实例的详细信息

DescribeNamespaces.description_en: Queries the namespace information of a specified instance
DescribeNamespaces.description_zh: 您可以调用DescribeNamespaces查询某实例下的项目空间信息

DescribeSupportedRegions.description_en: You can obtain information about the regions that support purchase
DescribeSupportedRegions.description_zh: 您可以获取支持购买的地域信息

DescribeSupportedZones.description_en: Retrieves information about zones that are available for purchase
DescribeSupportedZones.description_zh: 您可以获取支持购买的可用区信息

ListTagResources.description_zh: 您可以调用ListTagResources查询资源标签

ModifyPrepayInstanceSpec.description_en: Modifies the specifications of a subscription fully managed Flink instance
ModifyPrepayInstanceSpec.description_zh: 修改包年包月的flink全托管实例规格

ModifyPrepayNamespaceSpec.description_en: Modifies the specifications of a project space under a subscription instance
ModifyPrepayNamespaceSpec.description_zh: 修改包年包月实例下项目空间的规格

QueryConvertInstancePrice.description_en: Queries the price for converting an instance
QueryConvertInstancePrice.description_zh: 您可以查询转换实例时的价格

QueryConvertPrepayInstancePrice.description_en: Queries the price for switching from subscription to pay-as-you-go billing
QueryConvertPrepayInstancePrice.description_zh: 包年包月转按量付费询价

QueryCreateInstancePrice.description_en: Queries the price information for creating an instance
QueryCreateInstancePrice.description_zh: 您可以查询创建实例的价格信息

QueryModifyInstancePrice.description_en: Queries the price for upgrading or downgrading an instance
QueryModifyInstancePrice.description_zh: 您可以查询实例升降配时的价格

QueryRenewInstancePrice.description_en: Queries the price for renewing an instance
QueryRenewInstancePrice.description_zh: 您可以查询续费一个实例的价格

RenewInstance.description_en: Renews a subscription fully managed Flink instance
RenewInstance.description_zh: 续费一个包年包月flink全托管实例

TagResources.description_en: You can call TagResources to create resource tags
TagResources.description_zh: 您可以调用TagResources创建资源标签

UntagResources.description_en: Deletes resource tags by calling UntagResources
UntagResources.description_zh: 您可以调用UntagResources删除资源标签
